title: Email preferences
intro: Manage favorites reminders without signing in.
noScript: Enable JavaScript to use this link, or manage reminders in your account.
saved: Your email language has been saved.
stopped: Reminders are off. Changing language will not turn them back on.
enabled: Reminders are enabled. You can stop them here.
invalid: This link is invalid or no longer available. Open a valid link from your reminder email, or manage reminders in your account.
error: Your choice could not be confirmed. Try again to check the result.
conflict: The language changed elsewhere. Review the current choice and save again if needed.
disabled: Email preference links are not available yet. You can manage reminders in your account.
